ruling: 13 Nov: the video no longer says the story is fiction; the caption does

cut.text: Kathang-isip: ang digmaang ito, ang Trinity, ang Bakunawa, at kaming lahat.

keep_with_the_word.text: Kathang-isip: lahat ng sinabi mong walang pag-asa.
keep_with_the_word.why: Plot. Indio uses the tiyak/kathang-isip sorting as a weapon against Lucifer's lies. The ruling names it as a keep.

keep_with_the_word.text: Naputol sa ere ang bawat salitang hindi totoo, at naging abo bago umabot sa mga arko.
keep_with_the_word.why: Plot action. It says nothing about the story being fiction.

keep_with_the_word.text: Pinagtatalunan: kung bentahan nga iyon; at totoo, wala akong binago sa nakaraan, ang nakaraan ang bumago sa akin.
keep_with_the_word.why: Disputed history joined to a character's own honesty.

keep_with_the_word.text: Ang larawan ng anghel na naghimagsik, hinubog ng mga sumunod na tradisyon at ng tulang Paradise Lost ni John Milton, 1667.
keep_with_the_word.why: A fact about the real record, not about our story.

after_cut: Tiyak din: ang labanan sa Look ng Maynila, unang araw ng Mayo 1898. / Kaya ikaw, ka-Indio, i-comment mo.
